Remaining numerics look well-behaved: symmetric distributions, zero_ratio 0.0, few IQR outliers (7-15) and few z>3 points (1-8), so no severe skew. Recommended checks: confirm whether 9999 is a documented missing code; compare median vs mean imputation impact on the three sentinel features; test missing-indicator columns for predictive signal; verify train/test split is time-aware using signup_date given the temporal column.

The dataset is usable but not yet clean. The target is intact (binary, no missing values) and two numeric features (num_feature_05, num_feature_10) are complete, so there is a solid signal base. I also note the target is imbalanced (about 69% / 31%), so stratified splits and class weighting or resampling should be part of the pipeline. With the sentinel values recoded, a documented imputation strategy applied, and categorical cardinality handled, this would be ready to train.
